#!/bin/bash

## set variables 

FILE=~/bin/files/notes.txt

## make this pause the last call in all
## the other functions.
pause(){
 read -p "Press [Enter] key to continue..."
}

## functions
peruse(){
 less $FILE
}

list_notes(){
 echo
 grep "NOTE " $FILE
 echo
 pause
}

read_note(){
 echo
 grep "NOTE " $FILE
 echo
 echo -n "enter NOTE number: "
 read -e num1
 #echo -n "enter next highest number: "
 echo
 #read -e num2
 sed -n "/NOTE ${num1}/,/###/p" $FILE
 pause
}

edit_file(){
 sensible-editor $FILE
}
## menu
show_menus(){
 clear
 echo "1. call file with less pager"
 echo "2. list notes"
 echo "3. read note"
 echo "4. edit file"
 echo "q to exit"
}

read_options(){
 local choice
 read -p "Enter choice [ 1 - 4 ] " choice
 case $choice in
 1) peruse ;;
 2) list_notes ;;
 3) read_note ;;
 4) edit_file ;;
 q) echo Time to quit...; echo; exit 0; ;;
 *) echo -e "${RED}Error...${STD}" && sleep 2
 esac
}

trap '' SIGINT SIGQUIT SIGTSTP

while true
do
 show_menus
 read_options
done
exit $?
